description_en: Creates a compression rule configuration for a site
description_zh: 新增站点的压缩规则配置
name: CreateCompressionRule

parameters.help_en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version on which the configuration takes effect. The default value is version 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en:
Gzip compression. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
Gzip压缩。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: gzip

parameters.help_en:
Brotli compression. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
Brotli压缩。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: brotli

parameters.help_en:
Zstd compression. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
Zstd压缩。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: zstd

parameters.help_en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence
